question: Optimise the conditions for growing wild-type T cells from iPSC and output the best protocol reachable within the iteration budget.

desired_output.basis: Target set by the requester for this demonstration, and deliberately above what the designed baseline reaches so the loop has something to optimise. It is not derived from any published yield for an iPSC-derived T-lineage process.

qc_overrides.basis: Requester's demonstration limit on the CD3+ fraction; a real product limit is a QA decision.
Requester's demonstration limit on residual undifferentiated iPSC; a real limit depends on assay sensitivity and dose.
Requester's demonstration limit; a real limit follows USP <85> K/M for the intended dose and route.

genotype_arms.description: Unedited iPSC line. This request has no engineered arm: it asks only what the control alone can reach.

constraints.notes: Demonstration run against a synthetic stand-in reactor. No wet-lab work is authorised by this request.
